notes: «قلت لبلال» (Ibn Umar asks Bilal) and Bilal answers «كان يشير بيده»: Bilal is the one asked who answers, so he is the last link (rule 6)
«وقد روي عن زيد بن أسلم عن ابن عمر» gives the same saying through another transmitter: a variant group, not a route
Tirmidhi's remarks on the Suhayb hadith and on «وكلا الحديثين» name a different ḥadīth and are left out
